proof.conclusion: No artifact in the workspace, and no commit across the 38-minute window 23:12:25-23:49:52 UTC that brackets the 23:37:12 cutoff, has sha256 fb6aebf6. The workbook has been byte-identical e855a87f since before the envelope was generated and after it. The declared digest therefore attests to nothing observable and cannot be a transient working-tree state.

evidence_manifest_sha256.note: master_manifest.json is a live telemetry index regenerated every ~5 min (last_updated 23:36:28Z at the commit); a slightly newer copy at 23:37:12 is plausible. Not the fatal defect.

root_cause_hypothesis: The dispatcher hashes Data/DataBase_Trading.xlsx while the Excel pipeline daemon may still be writing it, producing a torn-read digest that matches no on-disk or committed state. Alternative: the envelope builder cached a workbook hash across generations. Both are silent integrity failures and both are fixed by the same change.

recommended_fix.change: Hash a byte-stable snapshot: stat the file (size, mtime_ns), stream sha256 twice with a short pause, require both digests equal and mtime unchanged; else raise. Emit workbook_bytes and workbook_hash_stable=true alongside workbook_sha256. Refuse to build the envelope if the workbook mtime is after cutoff or if the digest is not reproducible.
recommended_fix.verifier: Terminal/verify_cycle_envelope.py (added in this commit) re-derives every provenance field and exits non-zero on any mismatch.
